# Purchase College

> > Purchase College, State University of New York (SUNY) — a liberal arts college in Westchester County offering conservatory programs in performing arts, visual arts, and liberal arts and sciences.

Purchase College is located in Purchase, NY, approximately 30 miles from NYC. The institution is recognized for its distinctive combination of rigorous liberal arts education and professional conservatory training in disciplines including acting, art and design, and other creative fields.
